research_scope: Within-dataset WDBC evaluation with synthetic shifts; no external validation performed.

stages.baseline: Five classifiers, one stratified holdout split and five-fold CV on training set.
stages.stage3: Controlled synthetic shift experiments; four model families.
stages.stage4: No update vs probability recalibration vs full retraining.
stages.stage5: 10 seeds (200–209), Logistic Regression and Random Forest.
stages.stage6: 10 seeds (200–209), adaptive strategy selector using labelled monitoring data.
stages.stage7: 6 seeds (300–305), 2 model families, 11 conditions, 3 selector threshold profiles; 1,000 paired bootstrap resamples.

caveat: Not clinical validation, external validation, temporal validation or deployment-ready model.
